name: codex-guardian
description: Gate proposed Codex shell commands with a local automatic approval engine.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically run only shell commands that pass policy.
interface.longDescription: Codex Guardian adds a local policy gate for proposed Codex actions. Its guarded_shell_command tool automatically executes commands only when policy returns allow, blocks ask_user by default, and declines dangerous actions.
defaultPrompt: Run this shell command through Codex Guardian.
Gate this command and execute it only if allowed.
Review this proposed Codex action without executing it.
